description:
Employer company TotalEnergies EP Brasil Ltda

Context & Environment

Subsidiária recém-produtora com fases de exploração, avaliação e desenvolvimento em ativos operados. Os projetos estão predominantemente em LAPA (produção, projetos e perfuração de avaliação) e C-M-541 (perfuração exploratória com potencial para avançar para perfuração de avaliação).

  • Ambiente de alto custo com regulamentações locais rigorosas.
  • Contexto de águas profundas / ultra-profundas.
  • Poços exploratórios (ambiente sensível e remoto).
  • Assunção de uma instalação existente operada por terceiros.
  • Assistência contratual a ativos operados por terceiros (OBO – Operated by Others).
  • Alto nível de riscos técnicos devido aos custos operacionais.
  • Alto nível de objetivos de desempenho.
  • Trabalho em equipe dentro de uma estrutura enxuta.
  • Relacionamento com autoridades estaduais/reguladores, se aplicável.

O titular do cargo atua em um ambiente multidisciplinar de contratos e compras (exploração, perfuração, desenvolvimento, trabalho no mar e em terra) em um ambiente internacional e ambiente de conteúdo local simultaneamente.

A falta ou entrega tardia de materiais ou serviços, independentemente de seu valor, pode ter consequências importantes na produção e nas finanças.

O(a) colaborador(a) deverá desempenhar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE (Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente), alinhado aos Princípios do One Maestro e orientado para salvaguardar a integridade das pessoas, tendo em mente a preservação do meio ambiente e dos recursos, contribuindo para melhorar a eficiência energética e a descarbonização dos ativos da Empresa, bem como sua reputação.

As principais atividades do titular do cargo são:

  • Supervisionar o estabelecimento dos contratos, participando diretamente dos contratos e pedidos de compra mais complexos.
  • Validar ou garantir a validação de todos os documentos contratuais e cartas formais emitidas pela área de contratos e compras.
  • Participar de auditorias contratuais seletivas para garantir o cumprimento dos termos e condições contratuais.
  • Intervir na resolução de litígios, em conjunto com as áreas Jurídica, Seguros e Financeira, propondo estratégias e ações, e participando das negociações.
  • Definir e monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) para garantir a melhoria da eficiência.
  • Manter atualizados os conteúdos locais dos modelos de contrato (condições gerais e particulares), e adaptar versões internacionais às exigências locais.
  • Garantir o reporte global da equipe de Contratos e Compras à gestão da SCLC.
  • Definir, adotar e monitorar estratégias de contratação e compras adequadas (por categorias, etc.).
  • Promover uma cultura de melhoria contínua, sendo responsável por garantir o compartilhamento de lições aprendidas e boas práticas, não apenas com a SCLC, mas também com outras áreas da Empresa.
  • Realizar todas as atividades de contratação em conformidade com as políticas e procedimentos da Empresa e com a legislação brasileira.
  • Definir a estratégia de contratação em conjunto com o(a) contraparte do “Dueto” para atender e proteger os melhores interesses comerciais da Empresa.
  • Propor, pré-qualificar e recomendar contratantes/fornecedores adequados para listas de licitação, visando maximizar a eficiência dos processos de concorrência.
  • Compilar, emitir e administrar pacotes de “Convite para Licitação” para obter propostas realistas e comercialmente atrativas de potenciais contratantes/fornecedores. (Isso inclui revisar e compilar a parte técnica do pacote de licitação com base nas informações recebidas dos técnicos e fornecer aconselhamento comercial relevante).
  • Redigir termos e condições contratuais e comerciais apropriados para melhor atender e proteger os interesses da Empresa.
  • Revisar propostas, participar de esclarecimentos e negociações contratuais e comerciais, preparar todos os documentos associados, como apresentações, atas de reuniões, registro de qualificações contratuais e comerciais, minuta de recomendação de adjudicação, finalizar o contrato, administrar a adjudicação de contratos, ordens de mudança/variação, aditivos contratuais, reivindicações e toda a correspondência associada.
  • Revisar e considerar os aspectos legais associados à adjudicação e administração de contratos, em articulação com o Departamento Jurídico, fornecendo aconselhamento aos clientes conforme apropriado e auxiliando, quando necessário, na resolução de litígios.
  • Arquivar a documentação contratual e correspondências de forma lógica, organizada e auditável.
  • Participar da aprovação externa (Parceiros), revisando os boletins com as informações relevantes de C&P.
  • Garantir que todos os certificados contratuais, garantias, cauções e seguros exigidos no portfólio de contratos estejam em vigor dentro do prazo.
  • Facilitar reuniões necessárias para a condução das atividades do cargo.
  • Apoiar a equipe de Ativos Operados por Terceiros (OBO), participando de apresentações do Operador e assessorando nos aspectos contratuais e comerciais.

O titular do cargo gerencia a Conformidade:

  • Verificar que as Políticas de Contratos e Compras da empresa e as leis e regulamentos aplicáveis estão sendo seguidos, especialmente no que diz respeito à ética e transparência.
  • Verificar que os documentos e procedimentos de compras estão em conformidade com os padrões da empresa e com os acordos firmados com os parceiros.
  • Garantir a aplicação e o respeito aos procedimentos durante o processo de licitação.
  • Assegurar a aplicação das Condições Gerais de Compra da TEPBR, especialmente no que diz respeito a equipamentos complexos, de alto valor e alto risco.

O titular do cargo segue as regras de H3SE:

  • Servir como exemplo pessoal na adesão aos procedimentos de HSE da TEPBR.
  • Promover conscientização e fornecer orientação aos colaboradores sob sua supervisão quanto à execução das regras de HSE, tanto para funcionários da Empresa quanto para fornecedores, sem prejudicar as obrigações legais do Contratado.
  • Assegurar, para si e para os colaboradores sob sua supervisão, a segurança do ambiente de trabalho, evitando riscos às pessoas, às instalações e impactos ao meio ambiente.
  • Manter os meios de proteção individual e os procedimentos de emergência de segurança.
  • Realizar inspeções regulares e reportar quaisquer incidentes (anomalias, atos inseguros, quase acidentes, danos, derramamentos, lesões, etc.).
  • Notificar os colaboradores relevantes sobre acidentes, incidentes e quase acidentes, e iniciar ações corretivas.

Responsabilidades:

  • Preparar, negociar, adjudicar e administrar contratos/pedidos de compra de obras, bens e serviços de forma a garantir que os melhores interesses comerciais da Empresa sejam atendidos e protegidos.
  • Conduzir o trabalho de maneira a otimizar o desempenho em HSEQ (Saúde, Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Qualidade), a reputação e a lucratividade da Empresa, em estrita conformidade com os mais altos padrões de ética empresarial.
  • Estar em conformidade com os requisitos do Sistema de Gestão da Empresa (CMS) aplicáveis ao cargo, reportando quaisquer não conformidades à gestão direta.

O titular do cargo deverá garantir que:

  • As regras da Empresa sejam seguidas ou devidamente justificadas em caso de exceção.
  • As Especificações Gerais, Diretrizes e Manuais sejam considerados.
  • Os indicadores e KPIs sejam observados, monitorados e devidamente reportados.
  • Os objetivos de desempenho e eficiência de custos em Contratos e Compras sejam cumpridos.
  • O conhecimento técnico em Contratos e Compras seja compartilhado dentro do grupo TotalEnergies.
  • Sejam buscadas oportunidades de redução de custos e aumento de eficiência.

Competências de C&P (Contratos e Compras):

  • Competências técnicas avançadas em contratos e compras são exigidas.
  • Nível intermediário-avançado nas demais competências técnicas.

Qualificação e Experiência:

  • Formação superior (nível universitário ou acima).
  • Conhecimento e compreensão dos processos de compras, incluindo: princípios éticos; pré-qualificação de licitantes; convite para licitação; avaliação comparativa de contratantes; adjudicação, gestão de reivindicações, administração, alteração e encerramento de contratos.
  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência prática na preparação, negociação e administração de contratos de projetos complexos, preferencialmente na indústria de petróleo offshore.
  • Conhecimento profissional demonstrável e compreensão de questões comerciais, jurídicas e de seguros que afetam a empresa em geral, e compreensão aprofundada quando relevante para contratos de obras, bens e serviços.
  • Conhecimento geral e compreensão das funções empresariais da empresa, com entendimento aprofundado da função de contratos e de como ela agrega valor, além de compromisso em entregar valor agregado.
  • Deve ter proficiência em inglês e fluência em português.

Join to apply for the Senior Product Manager (Bangkok-based) role at Agoda .

We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7M hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees representing 95+ nationalities in 27 markets foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding and happiness. We are a skillful, driven and diverse team from across the globe, united by a passion to make an impact. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

Your opportunity

This role is BANGKOK-BASED, RELOCATION PROVIDED. The goal is to match you with the team that best aligns with your interests, competencies, and where you will have the most impact. We’re looking for Senior Product Managers for every part of our business. Our entire Product team sits in Bangkok. This is an Individual Contributor position.

You will get to:

Estamos buscando um Gerente Tributário para integrar nossa equipe tributária e liderar iniciativas tributárias estratégicas em nossas operações. Esta posição é ideal para um profissional dinâmico com ampla experiência em planejamento tributário, parcerias comerciais e modelos de negócios digitais.

Como Gerente Tributário Nacional, você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais para fornecer ativamente consultoria estratégica a líderes empresariais, orientando-os sobre a estrutura tributária de diversas iniciativas. Você gerenciará riscos tributários, identificará oportunidades de otimização e apoiará o crescimento dos negócios em um ambiente regulatório e digital em rápida evolução. Além disso, você será responsável pelo contencioso tributário no Brasil, coordenando e gerenciando escritórios de advocacia externos.

Responsabilidades e Deveres

Governança Tributária e Gestão de Riscos

  • Identificar e gerenciar riscos para garantir que as contingências fiscais sejam devidamente relatadas e documentadas, em conformidade com as políticas do Grupo Michelin.
  • Manter bom relacionamento com o fisco, promovendo a participação em programas de conformidade tributária.
  • Desenvolver e manter estruturas sólidas de governança tributária.

Contencioso Tributário

  • Definir a estratégia a ser adotada nas defesas administrativas e judiciais, considerando a interpretação da legislação, jurisprudência e peculiaridades empresariais.
  • Gerenciar a carteira tributária administrativa e judicial das empresas Michelin no Brasil.
  • Revisar periodicamente a previsão de sucesso do portfólio de processos, garantindo que as provisões realizadas sejam suficientes e adequadas.
  • Identificar oportunidades de ajuizamento de medidas judiciais ativas visando à recuperação de créditos tributários.

Reforma Tributária

  • Liderar análises estratégicas da reforma tributária, interagindo com diversas áreas de negócios para garantir a conformidade fiscal das empresas do Grupo.
  • Avaliar os impactos e oportunidades decorrentes das mudanças, visando otimizar a carga tributária, alavancar créditos tributários e adequar o modelo de negócios.

Planejamento e Consultoria Tributária

  • Desenvolver iniciativas de planejamento tributário e recuperação de créditos tributários.

Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar na análise e validação de estudos toxicológicos de substâncias químicas utilizadas no ambiente laboral, avaliando potenciais efeitos adversos à saúde dos trabalhadores, como toxicidade aguda, crônica, sensibilização dérmica / respiratória, efeitos reprodutivos e carcinogenicidade.
  • Contribuir para a avaliação do perfil toxicológico de matérias-primas, intermediários e produtos acabados com base em fichas de segurança (FISPQ / SDS), literatura técnica e bases regulatórias (como GHS, ANVISA, ACGIH, REACH).

  • Aplicar metodologias de Control Banding (CB) para substâncias sem limites de exposição definidos, visando o controle eficaz dos riscos à saúde ocupacional.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente a definição de EPI e EPC adequados, baseando-se nas características toxicológicas dos produtos manipulados.
  • Acompanhar a implantação e atualização do Programa de Proteção Respiratória (PPR), garantindo a compatibilidade dos EPR com os agentes químicos identificados.
  • Coletar e organizar dados para avaliação de exposições ocupacionais e auxiliar na priorização de ações corretivas e preventivas, com base no risco toxicológico identificado.
  • Apoiar a elaboração de documentos técnicos como pareceres toxicológicos, laudos ambientais, mapas de risco e análises de exposição ocupacional.
  • Realizar atividades de suporte aos temas de meio ambiente (segurança ambiental, licenças e relatórios).

Requisitos

  • Mínimo curso Técnico completo em Segurança do Trabalho, Meio Ambiente, Química, Biotecnologia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento introdutório em toxicologia ocupacional, higiene do trabalho e agentes ambientais.
  • Familiaridade com documentos como FISPQ / SDS, TLVs da ACGIH, normas NR-9 e NR-15.
  • Desejável vivência com controle de exposição a substâncias químicas e aplicação de ferramentas como Control Banding.
  • Conhecimento básico do Pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Sales Representative, Senior role at American Bureau of Shipping (ABS) — The Senior Sales Representative drives sales performance for ABS’ maritime training offerings. The Sales professional should be comfortable with ambitious targets, managing customer and partner relationships, and coordinating with regional training centers to broker learning solutions that meet customer needs. The professional will be central in articulating the value of ABS’ innovative maritime training solutions, ensuring customer satisfaction, and leveraging industry insights to position and sell maritime client training.

What You Will Do

  • Communicate the value of ABS training offerings to external customers, B2B partners, and internal collaborators.
  • Work with ABS regional academy managers to provide sales support and understand customer needs.
  • Own and manage relationships with ABS training customers and serve as the primary point of contact for sales.

  • Actively prospect and generate leads for maritime training customers and conduct on-site client visits.
  • Periodically attend training deliveries to better understand customer profiles and cultivate relationships.
  • Collaborate with other business development personnel within ABS to bundle and cross-sell training offerings to a wide range of ABS customers.
  • Strategically expand the buying relationship by identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling.
  • Review evaluation feedback from training participants, monitor and ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Respond to RFPs with proposals that highlight ABS’ strengths in delivering cutting-edge educational technology and compliance training.
  • Collaborate with teams across marketing, product management, and service delivery to ensure cohesive client strategies and high satisfaction levels.
  • Utilizes existing software and services for handling Client Relationship Management (CRM).
  • Provide support to consulting, development, and other sales groups as requested.
  • Attend events, client committees, and industry conferences to represent ABS and its training offerings.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends, particularly in alternative energy sources and digitalization.

What You Will Need

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Sales, Business, Marketing, Maritime Studies, or a related field.
  • At least ten (10) years of robust sales experience preferred, within the international shipping industry, with a proven track record of managing and expanding client relationships.
  • Experience and proven ability to sell to training customers in a B2B, for-profit commercial training market.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills and strong organizational and project management abilities.
  • Willingness to travel to meet clients, attend industry events, and engage with stakeholders across various regions.
  • Understanding of the shipping industry’s operational and regulatory challenges.
  • Strong interpersonal and team skills, including functioning successfully in a cross-functional team.
  • Ability to gain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management System.

Reporting Relationships

The Senior Sales Representative reports to a senior member of management within the ABS Learning Organization and has no direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Mission

The Senior Asset Integrity RBI Engineer plays a pivotal role in optimizing inspection strategies within the Oil & Gas facilities or power plant by implementing risk-based inspection methodologies. Their mission is to assess the integrity of equipment and facilities, prioritize inspection activities based on risk assessment, and develop cost-effective inspection plans to ensure asset reliability, safety, and regulatory compliance. #LI-KM

Risk Assessment and Analysis:

  • Conduct risk assessments of equipment and infrastructure using RBI methodologies.

  • Analyze risk data to prioritize inspection activities according to risk levels.

Inspection Planning and Optimization:

  • Develop risk-based inspection plans tailored to specific equipment and process units.
  • Determine appropriate inspection techniques, frequencies, and inspection intervals based on risk assessment results.
  • Optimize inspection schedules to minimize downtime and maximize asset integrity.

Data Management and Documentation:

  • Maintain comprehensive records of inspection data, risk assessments, and inspection plans.
  • Utilize software tools and databases to manage RBI data and documentation effectively.

Continuous Improvement and Compliance:

  • Identify opportunities for optimization and improvement of RBI processes and methodologies.

Communication and Collaboration:

  • Foster a culture of safety, reliability, and continuous improvement within the organization.

Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering General or Chemical Engineering

Qualifications

  • Extensive experience in risk-based inspection, integrity management, or asset reliability engineering within the Oil & Gas facilities or power plant industry.

About the Role

About the Role:

As a Software Engineer at BWZ you are responsible for the whole development process, starting with discovering, planning and developing, ending with testing and deploying. You will work in an environment that offers freedom with responsibility, and encourages simplicity with risk taking.

You will be working in BWZ's Tech Team, highly involved in the development of our back-end systems and integrations (using Node.js, Python, AWS, etc), but also participating on the development and architecture of our multi-site Web Platform (built in WordPress), our Ad Tech Platform (built in Ruby on Rails), among many other systems and products.

You can work remotely or in a flexible regime if you are in Curitiba, Brazil. Keep in mind that our teams work in the PST time zone, and your hours should be at least partially compatible with it.

What You’ll Be Doing

Reporting to the Technology Director, working in the BWZ Labs Team but also closely with the Web Platform. You will be tasked with the development of internal systems used by dozens of employees, as well as customer facing systems used by thousands of clients.

You don’t have to know all the answers, because you will have the time to research and learn new technologies and solutions, so you can make suggestions and implementations that might fit our product needs to better perform and scale.

Who You Are

  • You are a software engineer with meaningful experience building web applications .
  • You are good at curating your own priorities.
  • You are curious about how things are done and how they work.
  • You are good at communicating your deliveries and demands with pairs and stakeholders.
  • You don’t like repetitive tasks, so you automate everything you can.
  • You like to test new things, and you don’t mind if it doesn’t work and move on.

How Your Success Will Be Measured

  • We don’t like to measure effort, rather we try to focus on effectiveness.
  • You will be accountable for your results, not the hours you worked.
  • You will be part of a team, collaboration is a key factor.

Your Skill Set Includes

  • Curiosity to understand how things work.
  • An unbridled openness to learning new technology.
  • Great time-management and prioritization skills.
  • Openness to learn and use new programming languages.
  • You are comfortable reading and writing documentation for others.
  • Good communication in English.

Required Experience for this Position

  • Meaningful experience building web applications using high-level programming languages such as PHP, Python, Ruby, GoLang, or similar.

  • Experience with system design of web applications.
  • Experience with Javascript technologies such as React, Node.js, Next.js, or similar.

  • Experience with MVC frameworks.
  • Experience developing APIs and/or MCPs.
  • Experience writing tests and building deployment pipelines.

About Us

Black and White Zebra is a rapidly growing, independent media tech company headquartered in Vancouver, B.C. Canada. Since 2012, our portfolio of influential digital publications has been helping millions of people succeed at work.

Our brands cover project management, product management, people management, customer experience, quality assurance and others, with the goal of connecting people with the knowledge, skills and tools they need to succeed professionally.

We got our start in 2011 as The Digital Project Manager blog, founded by our CEO Ben Aston. Since then, we’ve grown into an international team of 70+ creators, strategists, and innovators with a portfolio of more than 14 online publications. We enjoy an impact-driven environment that combines the agility of a startup with the creativity of an agency and the diversity of a global company.

We’ve recently ranked #30 in The Globe and Mail’s Fastest Growing Company list and received a CMI award for Best Digital Publication for The Digital Project Manager—and we’re listed in both Canada's Top Small & Medium Employers, and Best Employers in BC.

All of this growth is driven by our commitment to our mission: In a world of evolving skills, practices, and technology, we’re creating a playbook for the future of work and empowering communities to create it with us.

description:

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We have created a new leadership role, Partner Marketing Director, to drive our Go-To-Market strategy across our partner ecosystem, from silicon to public cloud, through channel and hardware manufacturers. As the publisher of Ubuntu and the leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, we play a unique role in a variety of innovative value chains (Public Cloud, Cybersecurity, AI, IoT) supporting our partners both technically and commercially.
Reporting to the VP of Marketing you will lead a team of marketing managers running partner programs. You will work closely with our partners to make Canonical their trusted partner to deliver open source based products and solutions. In this role you will ultimately be responsible for maximising the overall ROI of our campaigns supporting our partners motions whether sell-to, sell-through or sell-with.
The partner marketing team is formed of multi-talented marketing professionals, as comfortable formulating joint value propositions as they are about running lead generation campaigns. They have an eye for creating remarkable messages/assets and a hand in the selection of the most effective channels through a complex supply chain. They are passionate about technology, the users of enterprise technology, and are early adopters of advanced partner analytics technologies.
Location: This role is home based in the AMER region.
The role entails

  • Building a marketing strategy that drives pipeline growth and revenue outcomes through key partners – Silicon, IHV, ODM, Channel, GSIs, etc.
  • Aligning with growth, field and product marketing to deliver activities integrated with Canonical's campaigns.
  • Owning the execution of partner campaigns across the funnel from recruitment to demand generation programs.
  • Engaging and elevating the partner community through exceptional content in partnership with the communication, product and alliances teams.
  • Multiplying our partners' impact through programmatic approaches.
  • Crafting bespoke plans and joint value propositions to stand out in the marketplace.
  • Championing our partner collaboration vision both internally and externally.
  • Managing the use of Marketing Development Funds (MDF) whether we receive it or distribute it.
  • Driving the adoption of advanced analytics and reporting tools to continually improve the ROI of partner marketing activities.
  • Mentoring and developing a diverse team of partner marketers covering our whole spectrum of partners.
  • Cultivating a culture of continuous testing and optimization.
What we are looking for in you
  • Strong understanding of the technology ecosystem including Silicon, IHV, ISV, ODM/OEMs, cloud service providers and channels is essential for this role.
  • Demonstrated leadership in aligning diverse partners around Go To Market strategies.
  • Proven track record of developing and executing successful co-marketing programs in the technology space.
  • Experience reporting on complex partner marketing activities and touchpoints.
  • Ability to create a culture of excellence, agility and self-drive in your team.
  • Curiosity with a habit of continuous learning.
  • Outstanding communications skills in English, both verbal and written.
  • Exceptional academic results both at high school and university.
  • Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.
What we are looking for in you
  • Familiarity with a particular vertical (e.g. Telco, Finance, Industrial, Automotive).
  • Experience in leading distributed teams across different time zones.
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Head of Cloud Alliances to lead business development and partnerships with the global public clouds. As the publisher of Ubuntu, Canonical is already a trusted partner with the leading guest OS and select services for the major hyperscalers. We have a large portfolio of open source software on the cloud marketplace for enterprise customers, and are looking to expand our global cloud partnerships.
Reporting to the VP of Global Alliances, the Global Head of Cloud Alliances will lead teams that bring innovation to the public cloud platforms, joint go-to-market with public cloud sales communities and marketplaces, and our global customer and partner contracts. They will work closely with cloud partners, from engineering to product management and marketing, to deliver open source solutions at scale for their cloud customers.
Our Cloud Alliance team builds trusted relationships with partners at all levels, from joint technical work to executive strategy. Their goal is to increase Canonical market share in the cloud ISV ecosystem, develop cloud channel sales, evangelize the partnership and lead all business interactions. The Global Head of Cloud Alliances will own the strategy, sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions with all cloud partners, as well as promotion of our cloud related activities - from campaigns, to strategic opportunities and cloud related events.
Our company is largely distributed, this role can be based anywhere in the Americas or EMEA.
The role entails

  • Taking ownership of Canonical's global cloud partner strategy, leading efforts to forecast, driving bookings, and growing revenue worldwide
  • Building strong, cross-functional relationships across teams to ensure a unified approach to technology and market execution
  • Inspiring and guiding teams to achieve accelerated revenue growth with Cloud partners, continually refining and evolving strategies for success
  • Establishing and nurturing executive-level relationships with key partners, laying the foundation for long-term success and mutual growth
  • Steering our offering from concept to execution, aligning product management and marketing strategies while scaling success through our global sales organization
What we are looking for in you:
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Exceptional leadership and presentation skills, capable of energizing teams and stakeholders while delivering compelling data-driven narratives
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • An in-depth understanding of open source technologies, Ubuntu, and the competitive ecosystem, with an eye for identifying opportunities that others might miss.
  • Autonomous, disciplined, and proactive—take ownership, and deliver exceptional results
Nice to have
  • A track record in alliance and indirect sales management, with an ability to build partnerships that drive success
  • Solid experience in the Public Cloud sector, coupled with an understanding of the evolving landscape of technology and innovation.
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

We have opened several senior/staff Security Operations Engineer (SOC) positions, creating a new team reporting to the CISO. We are looking for a range of experience in these positions - at the high end we are looking for deep experience defending highly contested critical assets and high-value cyber targets against advanced persistent threats and state-level actors. We have more junior roles for exceptional individuals with a proven personal interest an engagement in cyber attack and defence, and outstanding academic and career performance even if experience is limited.
Our goal is to build an entirely new level of assurance and observable rigour into the open source supply chain. We have our own estate to monitor, but more broadly our goal is to raise the robustness of the entire global Ubuntu estate through the work of this team.
The Security Operations (SecOps) team is responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.
The SecOps team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.
What you will do in this role:

  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture

  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice
  • Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives
  • Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical
  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials

  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice

  • An exceptional academic track record

Join to apply for the Solutions Architect (HubSpot) role at Origin 63 | HubSpot Solutions Partner

Origin 63 is seeking an experienced Solutions Architect (HubSpot) to act as a senior technical and delivery leader across our Sales and Services teams. This role combines sales support —leading deep technical discovery, designing scalable HubSpot-centric architectures (multi-hub deployments and integrations), and scoping Statements of Work (SOWs)—with delivery ownership of select enterprise client projects.

As part of delivery, you will also serve as a technical escalation point , providing guidance when complex blockers arise and ensuring projects meet quality and timeline standards. Operating at a caliber above our Senior Strategist role, the Solutions Architect sets the technical vision for complex client engagements , bridging the gap between business requirements and technical execution.

You will play a pivotal role in pre-sales engagements by delivering feasibility assessments, solution blueprints, and architecture reviews, while also providing governance and oversight during project delivery . Beyond client-facing solutioning, this role reports directly to the Director of Client Services , manages cross-departmental collaboration (Sales, Strategy, Delivery, Development) to maintain delivery excellence, and leads internal training sessions (Lunch & Learns and beyond) to elevate technical solutioning skills across the team.

This is a full-time position requiring 6 hours of regular overlap with our core collaboration hours (8 AM – 2 PM PT).

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Sales to lead deep technical discovery sessions, capturing both business goals and technical requirements across multiple HubSpot hubs and third-party systems.
  • Conduct fit-gap analyses to evaluate feasibility, risks, and trade-offs between custom development, native HubSpot capabilities, and integration options.
  • Produce detailed solution blueprints, integration maps, and architecture documentation that clearly outline system interactions, data flows, and security considerations.
  • Deliver executive-level presentations and solution demos/POCs to prospects, translating technical concepts into clear business outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Sales on technical proposal content and provide pre-sales input to improve win rates, including responding to RFPs/RFIs.
  • Scope Statements of Work (SoWs) with accurate estimates, identified risks, technical assumptions, and defined success criteria.

Solution Design & In-Project Technical Discovery:

  • Validate proposed solutions with both client and internal stakeholders to ensure alignment, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Translate business objectives into secure, scalable, and maintainable HubSpot architectures, with clear guardrails for implementation.
  • Define integration strategies (APIs, middleware, data syncs) for CRM, ERP, or marketing platforms to support seamless workflows.
  • Establish governance frameworks for data quality, user roles, and ongoing platform management.
  • Contribute to pricing and resource planning discussions by balancing feasibility, cost, and client impact.
  • Maintain a library of reusable solution patterns and documentation to improve future scoping efficiency.

Delivery Oversight & Enablement:

  • Oversee early delivery milestones to ensure alignment with the approved architecture and scopes, adjusting design where necessary based on real-world constraints.
  • Remain available as a technical escalation point during implementation to advise on blockers, integration issues, or unexpected scope changes.
  • Conduct architecture reviews at key delivery checkpoints to confirm adherence to solution design, security best practices, and client requirements.
  • Partner with Project Managers and Implementation teams to proactively identify risks and ensure project health.
  • Lead or participate in post-mortems/retrospectives, documenting lessons learned and updating best practices for future projects.
  • Report to the Director of Client Services, providing regular visibility into solution design quality, project governance, and overall delivery health.
  • Manage and align cross-departmental teams (Sales, Strategy, Delivery, Development) to ensure consistency and quality across all client engagements.
  • Lead 1–2 internal training sessions per month (Lunch & Learns and beyond) to elevate technical knowledge, solutioning practices, and team-wide competency.
  • Define, document, and enforce solutioning standards and best practices, ensuring scalable and repeatable delivery frameworks.

External Representation

  • Act as a senior technical representative of Origin 63 within the HubSpot ecosystem, engaging in sales opportunities (where HubSpot is directly involved) and representing the company at partner events.
  • Build trusted relationships with HubSpot Partner Managers, Sales representatives, and ecosystem stakeholders, demonstrating technical leadership and strategic alignment.
  • Strengthen Origin 63’s external reputation by contributing to case studies, speaking engagements, HubSpot community initiatives, and thought leadership content.

KPIs:

  • Blueprint Delivery: 100% of complex opportunities include documented solution blueprints, integration maps, and data architecture mapping, delivered in a standardized format (e.g., Miro + HubSpot/Confluence).
  • Escalation Support: 100% of escalations acknowledged within 1 business day, with ≥90% triaged and guidance provided within 2–3 business days (for assigned book of business and for projects that were scoped by you).
  • On-Time Projects: ≥90% of projects delivered within the committed timeline (≤2-week grace period).

The Security Operations (SecOps) team is responsible for the design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack. The SecOps mission extends to the wider open source ecosystem, sharing knowledge through public presentations and threat intelligence with the community or representing Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.

  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture

Our partner is a company where data drives insight and architecture drives impact. They provide advanced analytics and real-time data pipelines that power the foodservice supply chain.

Along with our partner, we are seeking a Senior Data Architect to design and evolve scalable, high-performance data systems in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and beyond. They work closely with data engineering, software development, product, and business teams to ensure their data architecture supports current and future business needs and build an AI-first engineering process for rapidly building new products. Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in designing self-service data platforms and data product models.

Benefits

The goal is not to be a full cloud of course. The goal is to give developers a local cloud on their workstation, which they can use to run builds in the background, or to try cloud appliances, or to test their own cloud deployments and cloud-init scripts, free of charge. Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems for global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Lead Golang Software Engineer at any seniority level, who strives for the highest engineering quality, seeks improvements, continuously develops their skills, and applies them at work. This is an exciting opportunity to work with many popular software systems, integrations technologies, and exciting open-source solutions.
The Commercial Systems unit is conceived as seven engineering teams that closely collaborate with other engineering and business teams at Canonical. Services designed, developed, and operated by the Commercial Systems unit are at the heart of Canonical business and Golang plays an integral role in it. We are looking for software engineers for these teams:
The Billing team designs, develops, and operates a Golang service that provides a standardized and scalable capability to turn metrics into billable amounts, enable customers to see their current spend with Canonical at any time, and ensure accurate, reliable, and timely billing. The service further integrates with other engineering, business, payment systems. This team is an excellent match for any software engineer interested in growing their skills in the billing and payment processing domain.
The Contracts team designs, develops, and operates a Golang service that will become the single source of truth for all contracts with all customers. The service provides a standardized CPQ capability and stores signed contracts in a structured format. The service further integrates with other engineering and business systems including a CRM system and an accounting system. This team is an excellent match for any software engineer interested in understanding sales and revenue processes and growing their skills beyond software engineering.
The Livepatch team designs and develops a service for the delivery of Linux kernel patches to shrink the exploit window for critical and high severity Linux kernel vulnerabilities, by patching the Linux kernel between security maintenance windows, while the system runs. The engineering team behind this product develops Golang based client and backend components, while another Canonical team, the Kernel team, develops the security patches. This team is a great opportunity for a software engineer interested in security and with a strong focus on engineering quality and reliability.
The Ubuntu Pro backend team designs and develops backend services for the delivery of Ubuntu Pro, the most comprehensive subscription for open-source software security. The engineering team behind this product develops Golang based backend components, while the Security team at Canonical develop security patches. This team is a great opportunity for a software engineer with a strong focus on engineering quality, software performance, and reliability of operations.
Location : This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region (all teams except for Ubuntu Pro) or the AMER region (Ubuntu Pro).
The role entails

  • Develop engineering solutions leveraging Golang
  • Lead technical designs, code reviews, and implementation
  • Deploy and operate services developed by the team
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback to colleagues
  • Develop and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices
What we are looking for in you

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our worldwide field engineering team apply expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu, OpenStack, Kubernetes, AI/MLOps and a wide range of associated technologies. We are experts in the whole open source stack, from kernel to desktop, from cloud to the edge. Our team is also interested in business problems - building things reliably, efficiently and cost-effectively, and we have to learn to speak the language of our customers and their industries.
We help global companies embrace public and private cloud infrastructure, cloud native operations, and open source applications. For this team we are looking for several Alliances Engineers to support OEM (hardware manufacturers), GSI (global system integrators), ISV (independent software vendors), Channel partners and Public Cloud alliance partners. You will support various alliances and partners of Canonical to adopt our products and technologies, help business leaders to define joint go-to-market programs with partners from the technical standpoint.
We often say that our field engineers have 'the hardest job at Canonical' because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer.   • Extensive experience with Linux (Ubuntu preferred), Kubernetes, Ceph, software automation
  • Experience designing and implementing solutions on top of public or private clouds
  • Python and bash understanding, troubleshooting skills
  • Fluent written and spoken English
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • High motivation, ability to multi-task and follow-up reliably on commitments
  • Interest in customer-facing engagement, including pitching, demonstrating and understanding customer environment and needs
  • Interest in new technologies like LXD, Juju and Snaps
  • Ability to travel globally up to 30% of the time
  • Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or related technical field experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Data Scientist, GivingTuesday
description:
About GivingTuesday
GivingTuesday is a global generosity movement unleashing the power of people and organizations to transform their communities and the world. The organization works with partners across sectors and borders to understand the drivers and impacts of generosity, explore giving behaviors and patterns, and use data to inspire more giving around the world. GivingTuesday offers the largest philanthropic data collaborative effort in the social sector — with unique, granular datasets from a wide range of organizations featuring key sector information

About GivingTuesday
GivingTuesday is a global generosity movement unleashing the power of people and organizations to transform their communities and the world. The organization works with partners across sectors and borders to understand the drivers and impacts of generosity, explore giving behaviors and patterns, and use data to inspire more giving around the world. GivingTuesday offers the largest philanthropic data collaborative effort in the social sector — with unique, granular datasets from a wide range of organizations featuring key sector information
As we scale up, we are expanding our team of data scientists, researchers and engineers, who will continue to grow and improve our unique data assets, methodologies, and technical infrastructure.
In pursuit of the goals and expansion of the data commons, GivingTuesday partners with key organizations to leverage their expertise to manage and lead different aspects of the work. These data & technology partners (DARO, With Intent) manage staff, projects, and ongoing functions for the data commons with dedicated staff embedded in GivingTuesday in those capacities in cross-functional roles. This role is one of these positions - managed by our partner organizations but embedded in GivingTuesday’s Data Team.
Data Scientist
Our global data science team works on a diverse set of problems and projects related to learning, insights, and impact measurement in the nonprofit sector. We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our growing team, where they will work with data engineers, analysts, and other team members to develop compelling and useful knowledge products for GivingTuesday stakeholders, including academics, data partners, the social/nonprofit sector, and the general public.
In this role you will:

  • Work with a wide range of data types including donation data, transaction records, government and census data, nonprofit tax filings, survey data on perceptions and activity, and philanthropic investment account data, gathered from collaborators and institutional partners in the nonprofit ecosystem
  • Deliver and write analyses with actionable insights and communicate these findings to cross functional stakeholders of varying technical levels
  • Manage key datasets and improve their usability by creating database dictionaries and user documentation
  • Improve existing data processing pipelines, automate recurrent operations on core datasets
  • Create impactful data visualisations and interactive data dashboards for stakeholders
We are looking for someone with:
  • Interest in the nonprofit and philanthropic sector and use of data to promote better social outcomes
  • Advanced analytical skills in a research context, conducting exploratory analysis and mapping data flows, integration of datasets, and reviewing data sources and tools
  • Experience with statistical methods including hypothesis testing, regression analysis, and sampling techniques for the purposes of social science research (such as economics, mixed methods) and/ or business analytics
  • Experience working with scripting languages (Python required) and data querying languages (SQL preferred)
  • Solid data visualisation skills and an aptitude for translating technical outputs into compelling stories
  • Experience with software development tools and practices (e.g. version control, testing outputs, and applying QA processes)
  • Understanding of legislation around privacy and best practices for securing data
  • Solid relationship management skills, with the ability to collaborate with a variety of internal and external stakeholders on complex research initiatives
  • Outstanding written and oral communication skills in English and an ability to communicate clearly and directly
  • Attention to detail and ability to synthesise diverse datasets
GivingTuesday is actively seeking candidates with unique and diverse work backgrounds to grow our team. We are especially excited to talk to you if have:
  • Programming skills: Python, PySpark, SQL, Databricks, Git, pandas
  • Data Manipulation and Exploration
  • Advanced Modelling: Regressions, Clustering, Dimensionality Reduction, Classification, Bayesian, Time-Series Analysis, prompt engineering
  • Experience working with data platforms such as Databricks (or other forms of cloud data lakes/warehouses/lakehouses)
  • An advanced degree in a quantitative research-field (definitely not required!). Non-degreed candidates must possess an extensive public record of competent, curiosity-driven data exploration on github, huggingface, kaggle, stackoverflow or similar
Location & Work Hours
Remote.
We are happy to consider applicants based in countries outside of where this is posted.
This is a full-time position. We are looking for candidates who can overlap with a 9:00 to 5:00 EST work-day, with some flexibility.
Compensation
Our compensation is competitive and tailored to align with cost-of-living differences across various regions. We look forward to meeting candidates from diverse backgrounds who can bring unique perspectives to our team!
For applicants in Brazil, our expected total annual compensation package is $144,000 BRL to $240,000 BRL.
GivingTuesday is committed to a work environment where our employees feel included, valued, and heard. We value diversity and welcome applications from Indigenous peoples, people from systematically excluded communities, members of the LGBTQ+ community, and people with disabilities. We welcome people from neurodiverse backgrounds. If you require any accessibility accommodation in the interviewing process please let us know.
We know that applying for a job takes a lot of time and energy and we treat every application with care and attention. Only those applicants who are selected will be contacted. To apply, please provide your resume and a short cover letter describing your interest in the position.

Overview

What We Do:

Huntress is a fully remote, global team of passionate experts and ethical badasses on a mission to break down the barriers to cybersecurity. Whether creating purpose-built security solutions, hunting down hackers, or impacting our community, our people go above and beyond to change the security game and make a real difference.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress protects all businesses—not just the 1%—with enterprise-grade, fully owned, and managed cybersecurity products at the price of an affordable SaaS application. The Huntress difference is our One Team advantage: our technology is designed with our industry-defining Security Operations Center (SOC) in mind and is never separated from our service.

We protect 3M+ endpoints and 1M+ identities worldwide, elevating underresourced IT teams with protection that works as hard as they do. As long as hackers keep hacking, Huntress keeps hunting.

What You’ll Do

The Huntress team is looking for an innovative and highly motivated Senior Software Engineer with excellent problem-solving and communication skills to join our Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR) team. In this role, you’ll build solutions to monitor logins, behaviors, and access patterns at scale to automatically detect and stop hackers in their tracks. You will work closely with senior engineers, security researchers, designers, and market experts to develop market-defining solutions for the identity protection space.

ITDR is the new frontier of security, with the vast majority of breaches in 2024 beginning with identity compromise. In this role, you will build scalable solutions to emerging threats in a rapidly evolving landscape. In many cases, you will work on problems nobody has solved before, with no existing template, so the ability to learn quickly and think outside the box is critical. You will work across the stack, building new UI one day, scalable data models and event ingestions the next, then wrapping up the week with automated detectors to alert customers and our SOC team to suspicious activity.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end solutions using primarily Ruby on Rails.
  • Implement efficient data pipelines to extract relevant information from massive amounts of noise
  • Collaborate with security researchers to understand hacking strategies and methods to combat them
  • Continuously improve solution quality through code reviews, manual and automated testing
  • Build internal tooling for our SOC team to hunt for and quickly mitigate any intrusions
  • Set standards for excellence and develop processes that make the team continuously more efficient
  • Lead junior engineers to deliver larger projects, including breaking down ambiguous problems into well-defined tasks, validating designs, and serving as POC for stakeholders
  • Mentor junior engineers and help them grow

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience developing complex software products
  • 5+ years of programming in Ruby on Rails
  • Experience working on Linux-based infrastructure

  • BS in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent experience gained through work experience

  • CloudWalk is an AI first company building its own technology to bring justice to the broken payment system in Brazil. We are building what one would call a “self-driving bank”.
  • Some people say a company is a unicorn when it reaches a valuation of over 1 billion dollars. We are one of those companies. But we are also a much cooler type of unicorn: a freaking amazing beast that is incredibly rare, cool as hell and damn hard to catch.

The R&D team

  • We love data.
  • We love living in a time when there’s access to an immense corpus of shared knowledge and incredible statistical and computational tools to extract meaningful information from the data.
  • We love thinking in high dimensions.
  • We like to explore before we exploit.
  • We sprinkle sci-fi references in everything we do.

What the job entails

  • You will be part of an exploration team inside the AI department. We take a step back from the day-to-day urgencies and pursue ambitious projects with high impact potential.
  • You will join our efforts to discover and refine transformer-based neural network architectures, data pipelines, pre-training objectives, and fine-tuning strategies that will power the next generation of machine-learning models for finance.
  • You’ll have access to tons of data, but you’ll also be cursed with tons of noise. Everyday events generate a torrent of perfectly normal behavior. To find truly valuable insights, you will need to follow clues, spot patterns, ask sharp questions, wrestle with uncertainty, uncover the story hidden in the numbers, and turn raw data into knowledge. You’ll need to be a detective.
  • You will stay on the cutting edge, diving into both seminal papers and the latest conference breakthroughs, distilling fresh academic insights into inspiration for practical experiments for our models.
  • You will have the chance to experiment. Do you think that the hot new model from a newly published paper can be applied to some of our data? Let’s try it! Do you think the atmospheric pressure, the migration pattern of birds or the number of capybaras living on the banks of the Pinheiros river are good predictors of credit card fraud or creditworthiness? Let’s investigate the data! Do you think there’s a different perspective to look at a certain problem that could solve it better or complement our current approach? Let’s put that to the test!
  • You will leverage ample compute resources to run ambitious training cycles, scale up ideas quickly, and iterate based on what you learned.
  • You might have taken a bunch of courses and learned all about NNs, CNNs, RNNs, SVMs, CARTs, RFs, LDA, QDA, XGB, BERT, SD, GPT, and all that nice stuff. Those are all techniques to learn a mapping from X to Y. Here, you will also have to think long and hard about what X you\'ll be mapping to what Y.
  • If you never allow yourself to fail, you will never allow yourself to take risks. The next big breakthrough will not come from someone who\'s playing it safe. Here, you\'ll be expected to experiment and you\'ll be allowed to fail, as long as you learn something. Over 99% of all species that ever existed on Earth are now extinct. But the remaining 1% would not have succeeded without them.
  • Not going to lie: sometimes you will have to do things you might not particularly enjoy. There will be times when we’ll be at war, when we’ll be together in the trenches, fighting the enemy, shoulder to shoulder, doing whatever needs to be done.
  • As a member of a fully remote and distributed team, you are expected to complete tasks autonomously, being highly collaborative and self-driven. We expect you to have the curiosity of a child with the responsibility of a grown-up.

Requirements

  • Deep ML intuition. You think naturally in embeddings, matrices, tensors, projections, gradients, and loss landscapes—and you can explain those ideas without a whiteboard meltdown.
  • End-to-end modeling skill. From data wrangling to metric-driven deployment, you spot promising ML opportunities and turn them into working systems.
  • Fluency in Python (and friends). PyTorch, TensorFlow, NumPy, pandas, SQL—you’re productive across the modern ML stack and pick up new tools quickly.
  • Data-driven detective work. You’re comfortable sifting through terabytes of noisy data to surface the patterns that matter.
  • Research mindset. Reading arXiv before breakfast, reproducing baselines, and adapting fresh papers to real problems feels like fun, not homework.
  • Parallel-experiment discipline. You’re organized enough to run and track multiple training jobs at once without losing your mind (or your metrics).
  • Clear communicator. You debate model choices and share experimental results—in English—across time zones. Portuguese is not required.

Recruiting process outline

  • Our selection method is simple but hard. If you pass, you are definitely smart.
  • 1) Online technical assessment
  • 2) Technical interview
  • 3) Cultural interviews
  • If you are not willing to do an online quiz, do not apply.

Join us at CloudWalk, where we’re not just engineering solutions; we’re building a smarter, AI-driven future for payments—together.

The successful candidate will be a rigorous and effective practitioner with a track record of academic achievement and social engagement.   • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial contracts with customers and vendors in many countries across the globe
  • Provide legal support to various internal clients across the company, including Canonical's sales organization
  • Interface with cross-functional teams to support company initiatives
  • Utilize Canonical's contract management system to ensure accurate data is maintained for signed contracts
  • Work with local counsel in many countries to seek and implement advice
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • A degree in law, JD or equivalent, and active license to practice law or current progress towards that
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-cultural environment
  • Effective both independently and as part of a team
  • A passion for technology evidenced by personal initiatives and projects
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Appreciative of diversity; polite and effective in a multicultural multinational organization
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience in commercial transactions, intellectual property, or corporate law
  • Leadership and the ability to influence others to embrace new ideas or practices
  • Understanding of the open source software community and values
  • Understanding of the technology industry - silicon, data centers, PCs, connected devices, and software
  • Experience working on in-house legal team and/or law firm
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
